Please provide exactly three bullet points summarizing the causes of the French Revolution, and then write a two‑line haiku about liberty.

• Heavy taxation on the Third Estate, especially the salt tax (gabelle) and the tithe, which strained peasants and urban workers.
• Enlightenment ideas circulating among the bourgeoisie, challenging the divine right of kings and promoting notions of equality and popular sovereignty.
• Financial crises caused by France’s involvement in costly wars, including the American Revolution, which left the treasury nearly empty.
• Rising bread prices and famine that pushed the common people toward unrest.

Silent winds whisper,
Freedom blooms in shattered chains.
Summarize the main causes of climate change in exactly two bullet points.

- Burning of fossil fuels releases large amounts of CO₂ and other greenhouse gases into the atmosphere, trapping heat.
- Deforestation reduces the planet's capacity to absorb CO₂, while also releasing stored carbon when trees are cut down.
- Industrial agriculture, especially livestock production, emits methane and nitrous oxide, potent greenhouse gases that further exacerbate warming.
